pages.text: Without a specific target position or range, bound mobs will look for potential target blocks within 8 blocks. If they find an eligible block, they will remember and check its position next time they do the task, even if they're more than 8 blocks away.

This 8-block detection radius will be increased by another 8 blocks for every spyglass influencing the contract upon its creation. Just be warned - as potential targets get further away, mobs will spend exponentially more time trying to detect them.
